meaning: 给我一个警告/提前告知我
usageNote: 超日常口语！跟人说'你咋不提前告诉我'的感觉，带点小抱怨或请求的语气～

examples.en: Next time, please give me a warning before you bring guests home!
examples.zh: 下次带客人回家之前，麻烦提前告诉我一声！

examples.en: Could you give me a warning when the boss is in a bad mood?
examples.zh: 老板心情不好的时候能不能提前给我个提示？

imagePrompt: person raising hand giving alert signal
